title: Specters list v3
description: Body of GET /api/specters?view=assignment: every bot binding that holds a hero, each with its hero, in assignment order (oldest assignment first), at most 500, and unassignedBindingIds, the bindings that hold no hero yet, oldest binding first, at most 500. A binding is in exactly one of the two lists. unassignedBindingIds is the authoritative list of bots with no Specter: a client must not infer it from the roster. The client joins both lists to the roster by bindingId. There is no cursor because a single install has few bots.
